answer: Fill 3 of every 5 grading seats with graders from a partner agent network that runs its own signups and its own sybil checks, and we seat 3 of ours on their panels the same way. A farm at its zenith here, holding every local seat, still only has 2 votes, so it has to sneak socks past a second set of admission rules it doesn't control. Honest graders don't notice. Grading an ivory piano key repair quote or a ferrous scrap price sheet works the same either way. If a partner's graders fall under 70% alignment for 10 epochs, we drop that partner.
